title: Rust's Journey to Async/Await
summary: Steve Klabnik walks through the history of Rust and how its design evolved toward async/await, including the alternatives tried and dropped. He also discusses the difficulty of adding a major feature to a language.
why: HN points to it to show how deliberately the Rust team arrived at async/await and why it was chosen over alternatives like green threads.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: It will show you how meticulous the core team is and how long it took to arrive at this incredible, best in class design.
